provenance.terms: IEEE materials are retained locally for personal use; this repository stores provenance and digests, not the standards source archives.

scope.definition: Verify official 2010 namespaces, symbols, overload forwarding, callback carriers, exceptions, encoder/time types, provider-factory discovery, and import/load/link behavior across pure Python, JPype, direct pybind, and JNI. Service behavior beyond the bounded proof slices is capability-gated and must remain explicit unsupported rather than implied by the surface inventory.
scope.completion_rule: A callable standard method counts as surface-bound when its name, overload shape, callback carrier, exception mapping, and provider load/link path are present. Invocation behavior is supplementary evidence; an explicit unsupported result is not a missing surface symbol.
not_required_for_surface_goal: complete DDM, MOM, save/restore, or time-management behavior
a parsed 2010 FOM in the deterministic reference directory

provider_boundaries.python_2010_time_factory_policy: LogicalTimeFactoryFactory honors hla.rti1516e.time_factories entries and otherwise discovers getTimeFactory/getFloat64TimeFactory from the edition-specific RTI providers.
provider_boundaries.policy: The 2010 C++/pybind and JNI artifacts expose the official rti1516e/hla.rti1516e surfaces. The direct C++/pybind route owns scalar, opaque, fixed-array, variable-array, fixed-record, and variant-record encoders, both mandated integer64/float64 logical-time families, connection lifecycle, federation membership and federate identity, declaration lookup/publication, receive-order object register/discover/update/reflect callbacks, receive-order interaction publish/subscribe/send callbacks, and object-attribute ownership query/inform callbacks. Its deterministic reference directory accepts standard FOM inputs while the 2010 FOM loader remains a separate gate; remaining RTI/MOM services stay explicit unsupported gates. JNI remains a bounded connect/disconnect null bridge. The JPype adapter may also consume a caller-supplied standard 2010 Java provider.

next_gate: Keep the 2010 symbol/factory/import/link contract green across pure Python, JPype, direct pybind, and JNI. Add DDM, time, save/restore, and MOM behavior only as optional provider capability slices; preserve explicit unsupported results and the deterministic reference-directory boundary.
